job.job_title: Senior Backend Engineer - Python & FastAPI ( Document AI Systems )
job.job_description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Python and FastAPI to design and scale a document-processing backend capable of handling large and complex PDF workflows.
The role focuses on building reliable, high-performance backend services that integrate with LLM APIs for AI-driven document classification, taxonomy-based validation, and compliance-oriented workflows.
The candidate will design systems supporting asynchronous processing, background workers, audit trails, and data lineage while ensuring efficient handling of long-running workflows and exception management.
Responsibilities include developing taxonomy-driven classification systems, implementing OCR-based document processing, assembling multi-page documents, and optimizing infrastructure and AI inference costs on Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with financial or compliance-driven systems and building scalable, production-ready backend architectures is highly preferred.
Location - Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Bengaluru , Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Remote.
